== Published English Original Virtual Set 7 wording ==
The remaster requires an alien pilot and drops the older uniqueness and bounty-hunter wording. It replaces the Boba Fett destiny threshold with a non-Maintenance requirement, and removes ship-docking. Other ship statistics and the Boba Fett piloting benefits remain.
